rubric.role_summary: Research Scientist developing machine learning techniques and advancing a research agenda through independent, long-running projects and collaboration across research teams.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Research Scientist developing machine learning techniques and advancing a research agenda through independent, long-running projects and collaboration across research teams.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Track record of developing new machine learning ideas or improving existing ones, demonstrated by accomplishments such as first-author publications or projects.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Past experience creating high-performance implementations of deep learning algorithms.
- Ability to own and pursue a research agenda, including choosing research problems and autonomously carrying out long-running projects.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
